page.overview:
What is Chainsaw?

A [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chainsaw Chainsaw] is a sharp and powerful motorized tool. The user pulls a cord to turn it on and activate the cutting chain. Unlike other tools, a chainsaw is powered by gasoline, although some are battery-powered. Chainsaws are primarily used to cut down trees. In horror fiction, serial killers sometimes use chainsaws to murder their victims.

Guest character Leatherface wields a chainsaw for gameplay, utilizing it differently between all his Variations in his combos, specials, Fatalities and Brutalities. His Killer Variation allows him to use the chainsaw for various attacks, charging and even unblockable, where the Butcher Variation allows from quick impalement for high damage, while his Pretty Lady Variation allows him to use it as a projectile.

The weapon reappears in Mortal Kombat 11 in the Black Dragon Fight Club as a stage interaction Krushing Blow as well as a Stage Brutality.
